name: Kijima Yoshiyuki
source:
Protagonist of the game.

Elite office worker, who works for a listed company with the position of department manager.

Has divorced his wife about 10 years ago and now lives alone in an apartment.

After divorce, in a moment of loneliness and desiring company, started engaging with dating websites and sexual industry.

Around that time, met [url=/c51072]Azusa[/url] who was a high school student. Kept engaging in physical relations for a little while since sexual compatibility with Azusa was great.

Sexual libido is enormous, character is sports-minded. During school days, was the leader of cheering team.

Even now, regularly goes to gym to train his body and has developed quite a macho figure.

In sex, also does variety of acrobatic sexual positions.

After divorce, has been venting out his libido mainly from sexual entertainment.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=913722&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
